subject: PO format and billing cadence - conditional Net60 / prepay option
messages:
From: Amanda Cole <amanda.cole@havencare.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Roberto Diaz <r.diaz@havencare.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Jun 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO format and billing cadence for Redwood services

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement at HavenCare needs to lock in a few billing items before we can issue a PO:

- We require the PO ID to be present on every invoice header and at line-item level when invoices reference multiple SKUs.
- Our standard payment term is Net60. Can Redwood accept Net60 for an enterprise agreement or is Net45 the default?
- We prefer monthly invoices but may accept biweekly batching if necessary. Can you confirm cadence options?
- Do you support separate invoices per legal entity (we have two billing entities) or does Redwood need a blanket PO with multiple lines?

Attached is our PO template (HavenCare_PO_template.pdf) showing the fields our AP system enforces. Can you confirm which fields are required so we can generate a compliant PO?

Also copying Roberto from AP — he’ll be the one to route the signed PO.

Appreciate a quick confirmation — procurement needs to have this in place to proceed with the order.

Thanks,
Amanda Cole
Sr. Procurement Manager | HavenCare Systems
Amanda.Cole@havencare.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference.com>
To: Amanda Cole <amanda.cole@havencare.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jun 2025 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO format and billing cadence for Redwood services

Hi Amanda —

Thanks for sending the template and the clear list. Short answers up front: we can support the PO ID on every invoice, we can invoice monthly (preferred) or biweekly in special cases, and we can accept split invoices to two legal entities as long as each invoice references the corresponding PO line(s).

A few details / asks from our side:

- Standard Redwood payment term is Net45. We can make a Net60 exception for enterprise customers on a case-by-case basis, but we need a commercial concession in return (either a prepayment on the first invoice or an early-pay fee schedule).
- For Net60 exceptions we require the PO to state the requested Net60 term and include a single point of contact for disputed items.
- For multi-entity billing: please include the legal entity name + remit-to address on each PO line. Our billing system needs that mapping to route invoices.
- Required PO fields from your template: PO Number, Billing Entity, Line-item SKU/Description, Quantity/Amount, Requested Payment Term, Remit Address. Optional: Cost Center / BU code.

I’m looping in Vanessa from Billing to confirm the ERP mapping we need, and Markus from Finance to review the Net60 exception path and the prepay options. I’ve attached our invoice SLA that shows how we format line-level data (redwood-invoice-sla.pdf).

Proposed flow:
1) HavenCare sends signed PO(s) with the fields above.
2) Redwood runs a quick onboarding validation (same-day) and confirms acceptance.
3) First invoice may include a one-time 10% prepayment (applied as credit) if HavenCare needs Net60. Subsequent invoices will follow the agreed cadence and reference the PO.

If that overall approach works, we can issue a short amendment that captures Net60 + prepayment terms and finalize commercial paperwork.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Partnerships (Americas) | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference.com

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
To: Amanda Cole <amanda.cole@havencare.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jun 2025 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO format and billing cadence for Redwood services

Amanda — quick note from Billing.

We need the following mapped exactly in your PO to avoid manual edits and payment delays:
- PO number (exact 10-char string in field: "PO_NUM")
- Billing entity (legal name) and remit address (we validate against tax records)
- Line-level SKU code (Redwood SKU format: RWINF-XXXX) or full description if SKU not available
- Invoice currency (USD) and preferred remittance instructions (ACH or wire)

If you can provide your ERP vendor code for HavenCare we can add it to our vendor whitelist now. Our vendor ID for Redwood is RFWD-1002 — include that in your onboarding form.

Also, to be clear on cadence: monthly invoices hit on the last business day of the month. If you prefer biweekly, we need an explicit schedule (e.g., 1st & 15th). Mixed cadence across entities adds a small reconciliation fee (typical for split remits).

Happy to sync a 15-min call to walk through the template fields with your AP team.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Amanda Cole <amanda.cole@havencare.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Roberto Diaz <r.diaz@havencare.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Jun 2025 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO format and billing cadence for Redwood services

Thanks, Sofia & Vanessa — that all looks reasonable. A couple of follow-ups from our side:

- Our AP policy: Net60 is standard, but we can agree to a 10% prepayment on the first invoice if Redwood requires it as a condition of Net60. Alternatively, we could do Net60 with a 1.0% per 30-day fee (commercially similar to an early-pay charge). Which would you prefer?
- HavenCare ERP vendor code is HC-55321. I will include RFWD-1002 in our onboarding form as requested.
- We’ll provide separate POs for the two legal entities; each PO will clearly map line items to the correct entity.

I can confirm our AP team will sign and send the POs by end of day Thursday if we can lock the terms. Would Redwood be able to accept the 10% prepay approach for Net60?

Thanks,
Amanda

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference.com>
To: Amanda Cole <amanda.cole@havencare.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Jun 2025 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO format and billing cadence for Redwood services

Amanda — great, thanks for the quick turnaround and for sharing HC-55321. We’re happy to take the 10% prepay on the first invoice in exchange for Net60 across the contracted term. A couple of small operational asks to finalize:

- Please include the following language on the PO: "Net60 per contract, conditional on 10% prepayment on first invoice applied as credit; Redwood vendor RFWD-1002." That explicit phrasing keeps our systems aligned.
- Confirm the remit preference (ACH vs wire) on the PO so we can populate remittance instructions prior to sending the first invoice.
- Once we receive the signed PO(s) we’ll run the onboarding validation and send an acceptance email the same business day.

I’ll draft a 1-paragraph amendment capturing Net60 + 10% prepay and share a DocuSign link (I’ve added a link to the HubSpot opportunity in related_links). Markus will run a quick compliance spot-check post-acceptance.

If all looks good we can close for signature by Thursday.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Partnerships (Americas) | Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.inference.com
